Level 4 - Advanced50 min

Classic Concurrency Problems (FooBar, H2O, Dining Philosophers)

Eight famous "make the threads take turns" puzzles, solved with our own Java 21 and C++14 code. You learn the six tools that solve all of them (latch, semaphore, barrier, monitor, lock ordering, executor), how to pick the right one in under a minute, and how to explain it in an interview.
